response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
